author: Matt Larkin

In 2003, Crystal Dynamics released Legacy of Kain: Defiance, the fifth game in the gothic fantasy, Legacy of Kain series. The game offered a partial conclusion to the epic story created by the prior games, and for decades, that conclusion seemed all fans would ever get.
